senses.gloss: (√רע, cmp. רוּעַ, Hif. הֵרִיעַ, cmp. קָרָא a. קָרָה) to proclaim a festival.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 147:1">Sifré Num. 147</cite> <he>אֵירְעוֹ במאכל וכ׳</he> proclaim it (as <he>מקרא קדש</he>) with special meal and dress; v. Mekh. Bo 9, beg.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 113b">B. Bath. 113ᵇ</cite> with <he>והיתה … משפט</he> (<cite ref="Numbers 27:11">Num. XXVII, 11</cite>) <he>אוֹרְעָה כל וכ׳</he> the whole section has been proclaimed as of a judicial nature; (Ms. M. <he>הודעה</he>, v. <cite ref="J00106"><he>יָדַע</he></cite>).
